🧭 How EndaViral Works · Lesson 3 of 5

Payments, Refunds & the Rewards You're Already Earning

5 min read · Updated November 2026 · Free · Written for Kenya
Share: WhatsApp X Facebook Telegram LinkedIn

The most dangerous M-Pesa prompt is the one you didn't start. If a PIN request pops up and you didn't just tap Pay, cancel it.

Paying on EndaViral is built to be quick: an STK push prompt lands on your phone, you enter your PIN, and the order starts by itself once M-Pesa confirms. A few rules about minimums, timeouts and refunds keep that money safe.

How the money moves

  • Minimum KES 20 for deposits and orders. It's there so you can test any service cheaply before a bigger order.
  • STK push only. You start the payment on EndaViral, and the prompt shows up on the phone number you entered. Check that number before you tap Pay.
  • Wallet refunds. If an order fails or only partly delivers, the undelivered part goes back to your EndaViral Wallet, ready for your next order.
  • No refund for wrong links. The service delivered, just to the wrong place. That's why Lesson 1 drills link-checking.

What to do when something looks off

What you seeWhat it usually meansYour move
Prompt never arrivedWrong number, phone offline, or SIM menu busyCheck the number and signal, then retry once
Prompt timed out before you entered your PINNo money left your accountStart a fresh payment. No need to panic
M-Pesa SMS says paid, order not showingConfirmation still syncingWait a few minutes, check My Orders, then open a ticket with the M-Pesa code
Order says PartialSome of it couldn't be deliveredThe missing part is refunded to your Wallet
Order stuck for hoursDelivery queue or a link issueDon't re-order. Open a ticket with the order ID
✗ MYTH

If it looks stuck, pay again. It'll go through faster.

✓ REALITY

Paying twice means two orders aimed at the same link, which can stack into exactly the kind of sudden spike you want to avoid. One ticket with the order ID lets support trace the original order.

Scam check, M-Pesa edition

Safaricom says its staff will never ask for your M-Pesa PIN, and it only calls from 0722000000. Never dial a code a caller reads out to you. Forward suspicious SMS to 333. No EndaViral order ever needs your PIN typed anywhere except the official prompt on your own phone.

The rewards hiding in your order history

  • Every 5 orders earns you 1 free order. Five small orders count the same as five big ones, which is one more reason to test small first.
  • Loyalty points build up from your orders and can unlock premium Academy lessons, so regular customers can learn the paid material without paying cash.
💡 The KES 20 habit

Before any order above a few hundred shillings, run a KES 20 test of the same service on the same link. You confirm the link works, see the real start time, and it counts toward your next free order. That's three wins for the price of a soda.

✅ Do this today
⚡ Quick check

Your order shows 'Partial': 700 of 1,000 delivered. What happens to the money for the missing 300?

Failed and partial orders refund the undelivered part to your Wallet. The only order type that can't be refunded is one sent to a wrong link.

🧠 Key takeaways
  1. Only enter your PIN on a prompt you just started. The minimum is KES 20.
  2. Partial or failed orders go back to your Wallet. Wrong links don't.
  3. Never re-pay a stuck order. Open a ticket with the order ID.
  4. Every 5 orders earns a free one, and loyalty points can unlock premium lessons.
